title: Join orders and users
code:
SELECT u.username, o.id AS order_id, o.total
FROM orders o
JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id
WHERE o.total > 100
ORDER BY o.total DESC;

title: Aggregate by language
code:
SELECT language, COUNT(*) AS tests, AVG(wpm) AS avg_wpm
FROM results
WHERE mode = 'code'
GROUP BY language
ORDER BY avg_wpm DESC;

title: Rank scores with window
code:
SELECT username, wpm,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY wpm DESC) AS position
FROM results
WHERE mode = 'general'
ORDER BY position;

title: Recursive CTE for tree
code:
WITH RECURSIVE subordinates AS (
  SELECT id, name, manager_id
  FROM employees
  WHERE manager_id IS NULL

  UNION ALL

  SELECT e.id, e.name, e.manager_id
  FROM employees e
  JOIN subordinates s ON s.id = e.manager_id
)
SELECT * FROM subordinates;
